agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. The ear is in the bin and a new row just went down under clear sky — push moisture onto the sprout before the ditch only slows the sip.
today.expect: East field near the brim so the sprout holds through another clear day.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms, but a ripe ear left standing while dawn still takes two corn is the other ending. Pull it while the ditch still holds the gauge.
yesterday.expect: Corn in the bin and an empty field before the ration can outrun the crop.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve — and the next row is already in. Ditches compound. Heat does not wait; timber while the sprout advances is the other compounding play.
today.expect: Wood pile thicker before the sprout asks for hands again.

yesterday.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve. The second Bob clears the ear, the next row goes in — heat does not wait for an empty sack.
yesterday.expect: A seeded row catching tomorrow's moisture while the harvest sits in the bin.
